I have been an avid reader of science fiction and fantasy for decades (since my teens in the 70s) (and have now started writing myself). Among my favorites are the stories from the Honorverse or Safehold, by now in the English original. But also "Sword of Truth", "Wheel of Time" or the "Alliance-Union-Universe" by Cherryh. And, of course, "A Song of Ice and Fire". A relatively new discovery is "War of Archons".
